## Goal

Prevent a repeat of incident `90c7-c465-4037-42d5` (the scanner-integration hard lock): a NEW blocking CI check (`scanner-integration`) was wired directly into the required Verified vote aggregate in `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`, failed on every full-route change, and produced a fleet-wide CI lock that only a human force-submit could break. Establish a durable policy — as an Accepted ADR plus lean agent guidance — that a new gate may only join the required "hot path" AFTER it has demonstrated a passing CI run running independently (advisory / non-blocking) on `main`.

## Policy (the decision to record)

- Before any new check is added to — or promoted into — the required Verified vote aggregate (the "hot path") in `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`, it MUST first run as an ADVISORY (non-voting, non-blocking) job and show at least one passing CI run on `main` independent of the hot path.
- Only after that independent green run may a separate, subsequent change promote it into the vote aggregate's blocking `needs`/route conditions.
- SCOPE: this applies ONLY to modifications of `.github/workflows/**` that add or promote a REQUIRED gate into the Verified vote aggregate. It does NOT apply to ordinary test-suite additions (new tests under `tests/` run by the existing suite are unaffected).
- Rationale: a gate wired straight into the aggregate that fails self-referentially locks the fleet, because the fix itself is full-route and cannot earn Verified +1 — exactly what happened in 90c7. Sibling precedent: ADR 0110 (change shape enters the floor as an advisory first).

## Scope / Deliverables

- `docs/adr/0114-<slug>.md`: NEW ADR, `Status: Accepted`, dated, with Context (cite incident 90c7 and the `gerrit-verify.yaml` vote aggregate self-lock), Decision (advisory-first + independent passing run before hot-path promotion; scope limited to GHA workflow gate additions; excludes test-suite additions), and Consequences.
- `docs/adr/README.md`: regenerate the ADR index to include 0114 via `scripts/gen_adr_index.py` (do NOT hand-edit the generated index).
- `AGENTS.md`: add a ONE-LINE pointer to ADR 0114 in the Git-workflow / CI section (keep the file lean per its own policy; do not restate the ADR).

## Design Decisions

1. ADR number is 0114 (main's highest is 0113). If a concurrent change takes 0114, use the next free integer and rerun the generator.
2. The ADR index in `docs/adr/README.md` is GENERATED; edit it only via `scripts/gen_adr_index.py`, then validate with `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` and `scripts/check_docs_index.py`.
3. AGENTS.md guidance is a lean pointer only (the repo's AGENTS.md policy forbids restating documented content); the authoritative text lives in the ADR.
4. This is a docs/guidance change: no source or workflow behavior is modified (the policy is process guidance, not a new gate).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `docs/adr/0114-<slug>.md` exists with `**Status:** Accepted`, a date, and Context/Decision/Consequences sections; Context cites incident `90c7` and the `gerrit-verify.yaml` Verified vote aggregate; Decision states advisory-first + an independent passing CI run before hot-path promotion.
- [x] The Decision explicitly scopes the rule to `.github/workflows/**` changes that add/promote a REQUIRED gate into the Verified vote aggregate, and explicitly EXCLUDES ordinary test-suite additions.
- [x] `docs/adr/README.md` lists ADR 0114, produced by re-running `scripts/gen_adr_index.py` (not hand-edited).
- [x] `AGENTS.md` contains a single-line pointer to ADR 0114 in the CI/Git-workflow guidance.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` passes.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_docs_index.py` passes.
- [x] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` passes.

## Testing

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_adr_numbers.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_docs_index.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`

## Out of scope

- Do NOT modify `.github/workflows/**` or add/change any actual CI gate; this ticket only records the policy and guidance.
- Do NOT restate ADR content in AGENTS.md beyond a one-line pointer.
- Do NOT re-add the reverted scanner-integration work (that redo is tracked under `b973`).
